findings.title: Wire the accepted timeout into the shutdown drain
findings.body: Setting [general].shutdown_drain_timeout = 120.5 is now accepted and preserved by the model, but with no environment override the scheduler still selects the hardcoded 60.0 default (triggarr/search/scheduler.py:70–81). Shutdown uses that constant at line 634 and closes resources after expiry, ignoring the configured drain budget. The TOML loading path in triggarr/config.py:load_settings exposes this setting now; this is more than an unused internal field.
findings.recommendation: Resolve the drain timeout from the current settings at shutdown, applying the environment override with finite-value validation. Add an integration test proving a nondefault TOML timeout reaches asyncio.timeout.

next_steps: Connect the field to shutdown before shipping it as a configuration option.
